verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs show background automation: continuous automated testing and evidence collection, a TPRM Agent that discovers and monitors vendors, automated reminders and workflows, and user-defined Custom Tests that turn pushed data into pass/fail evidence. However, the evidence does not document a general user-facing way to build, schedule, or trigger custom autonomous automations, so the 'set up' part is thin. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation/workflow builder with schedules or triggers, detail on what agents do unattended versus with approval, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Vanta automatically gathers the evidence you'll need to get compliant, and continuously monitors your systems to make sure you stay compliant and secure.
Vanta's TPRM Agent automatically discovers vendors, accelerates assessments, and monitors third-party risk.
Vanta automates reminders and workflows to regularly assess
Push user accounts and custom resources from a homegrown app into Vanta, then turn that data into pass/fail evidence with a Custom Test.
